policy.source: Copied from week1/fixtures/narration/prompt-policy.json (v1) and week1/docs/design/VOICE_PROMPTING.md; Week 4 short-form exceptions below.

lines.text: [softly] Nineteen-eighties Paris. Stay with me a moment.
lines.shortFormException: Opening promise; the construction minute carries the rest.

lines.text: [warm] Let it rain, then. We're under the awning.
lines.shortFormException: Follow-up acknowledgement during an in-place change.

lines.text: [calm] The lamps come on about now.
lines.shortFormException: Follow-up acknowledgement during an in-place change.
Undo acknowledgement when the restored look is rain.

lines.text: [calm] I haven't built that one yet. I can make it rain, bring the evening, or take you home.
lines.shortFormException: Honest refusal; nothing is generated or claimed.

lines.text: [softly] Let's go back. I'll restore what I changed.
lines.shortFormException: Spoken during the five-second graceful return.

lines.text: [calm] This is my picture of the eighties, not a record of one day.

lines.text: [calm] Undo the last change, or go home?
lines.shortFormException: Proposed clarification for an ambiguous 'go back'; owner review pending.

lines.text: [calm] One change at a time. Which first?
lines.shortFormException: Proposed clarification for combined requests; owner review pending.

lines.text: [calm] I didn't catch that. You can ask for rain, the evening, or to go home.
lines.shortFormException: Proposed reply for unrecognized or negated requests; owner review pending.

lines.text: [calm] Something went wrong. I'm putting your desktop back.
